title: Greenhouse Gas Auditor: Mexico deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?
One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.
Show proof: a clear report with sources, method notes and a result the client can act on.
Start with one customer type and one boundary, such as direct fuel and power use for a small firm.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster F, Food and farming: Strong fit: food and farming are central; check health-risk rules for food and alternative proteins. Check with a local expert.
Some activities need extra licences (food, health, tourism, money); list yours before the first order. Check with a local expert.
Employers register staff for social security and pay the year-end bonus; budget both.
Local caution: A large country: start in one city, test one offer, then grow.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Trust: tax ID, address, delivery days and a refund note on every page; consumer rules apply. Check with a local expert.
Keep a list of every tool that stores customer data, including messaging apps.
Handle client records with care: copy only the bills you need, keep a source list, set a deletion date.
Register with the tax authority (a tax ID) before you invoice; choose sole trader or company. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.
Issue electronic invoices as the tax rules require; learn the tool before the first customer. Check with a local expert.
Price per audit by hours and add margin; check arithmetic.
Keep a list of every tool that stores customer data, including messaging apps.

questions.q: In "Find and serve customers Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster B, Technology and digital services: Strong fit: near-shoring means firms need IT support, testing, security and cloud services in Spanish.
Payments: bank transfer, cards and cash-payment points; show prices with the sales tax clearly. Check with a local expert.
Electronic invoices are part of daily trade: learn them in week one.
Compare three models: one-off audit, a yearly programme, training and tools. Pick by repeat income.

questions.q: In "Price, tax and money Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Written contracts and signed copies for every helper, even part-time.
Local caution: A large country: start in one city, test one offer, then grow.
Register with the tax authority (a tax ID) before you invoice; choose sole trader or company. Check with a local expert.
Write MXN next to every number.

questions.q: In "People and partners Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Contribution per unit = price minus the cost of each unit.
Written contracts and signed copies for every helper, even part-time.
Launch with a go or no-go rule: 3 paid audits in 8 weeks, each with a source-linked report and one renewal. Check with a local expert.
Language: Spanish first, in plain words; add English only if customers ask.
